basic_profile.bio: I'm a small business owner based in New Jersey, always on the go trying to balance work and family life. I manage a team of 10 employees and am constantly navigating the challenges of running a business. I enjoy relaxing by watching classic cartoons and exploring niche interests on Reddit during my downtime. I'm usually online in the evenings after work. Married with two kids, I’m always on the lookout for solutions to streamline my business operations and improve customer service.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration and have been running my own small business for the past 5 years. Most of my expertise comes from hands-on experience and learning from online resources and communities.
